summary: Implemented the SHACL path parser. New files: rdflib/extras/shacl.py (parse_shacl_path and SHACLPathError) and test/test_extras/test_shacl_extras.py. Running test/test_extras/test_shacl_extras.py and test/test_path.py gives 42 passed. Nothing is committed. Not verified: mypy and black are not in the prepared venv, so the type-check and formatting gates were checked by reading the code only. Non-node inputs such as None and plain strings are rejected up front because Graph.value treats None as a wildcard.
